EX-99.1 2 q2fy2026roivantearningsrel.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 Roivant Reports Financial Results for the Second Quarter Ended September 30, 2026, and Provides Business Update • LISRAYA™ (brepocitinib) generated net product revenue of $31.0 million in its first 5 weeks of launch following FDA approval in August 2026 • IMVT-1402 600 mg met the primary endpoint of ACR20 response at Week 28 (92.5% vs. 75.6% placebo, p=0.0139) in Period 2 (randomized withdrawal design following open-label lead-in) of the potentially registrational trial in patients with difficult-to-treat rheumatoid arthritis (D2T RA); FDA discussions planned for later this year to determine the path forward regarding the registrational program for IMVT-1402 in D2T RA • Brepocitinib met the primary and all key secondary endpoints in the Phase 3 CLARITY-1 and CLARITY-2 trials in non-infectious uveitis (NIU); sNDA submission for NIU expected in the first half of calendar year 2027 • Mosliciguat demonstrated positive topline data in the Phase 2 PHocus study in pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD); Phase 3 PHrontier study initiated • In light of the evolving Sjögren’s disease (SjD) landscape and recent data in the field, we expect it is unlikely that we will advance IMVT-1402 further in SjD beyond the ongoing, fully enrolled Phase 2 trial • Roivant reported consolidated cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities of $4.2 billion as of September 30, 2026, including the cash payment received from Moderna in July, supporting cash runway into profitability • Roivant will host a live conference call and webcast at 8:00 a.m.

• Pulmovant : Mosliciguat demonstrated positive topline data in the Phase 2 PHocus study in PH-ILD; the study met its primary endpoint, demonstrating a clinically meaningful and statistically significant placebo-adjusted reduction in pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR) of -56.3% (p<0.0001) at Week 16, the highest ever reported PVR reduction in any randomized controlled PH trial.

Major Upcoming Milestones • Priovant intends to file an sNDA for brepocitinib for the treatment of NIU in the first half of calendar year 2027 and expects topline data from the Phase 3 study in CS in calendar year 2028.
Immunovant expects to report topline data across potentially registrational trials of IMVT-1402 in GD and MG in calendar year 2027.
In calendar year 2028, topline data are expected for the potentially registrational trial of IMVT-1402 in CIDP.
